exposure: Double Test Group (cervico-vaginal swab at 12-14 and 20-22 weeks)
Single Test Group (cervico-vaginal swab at 20-22 weeks)
cohort: 285 women with twin pregnancy in the Single Test Group and 199 women with twin pregnancy in the Double Test Group, followed up at Sant'Anna Hospital, Turin (Italy)
finding: Early screening for LGTIs and bacterial vaginosis at 12-14 weeks of gestational age in asymptomatic women with twin pregnancy was effective in reducing the risk of pPROM.
